pages.text: Water had frozen overnight, making the alley slippery. The three decided to visit the shop.
Kiki wanted fresh bread while it was warm. Nono offered a hand. "Slippery, so hold on as we go."
Gugu accidentally stepped on Kiki's tail. Kiki stood with their back to both friends.
"I will go alone." Kiki walked ahead.
A foot slipped across the ice. Kiki landed on their bottom.
After only a few more steps, Kiki fell again. Their bottom was damp.
Nono and Gugu were already at the shop. Kiki was still in the middle of the alley.
Grandpa Badger had scattered ash on slippery patches. He held an arm out to Kiki.
Kiki held Grandpa's arm, then Nono's hand too.
All three walked together, holding on side by side. Kiki hugged warm bread close.
